mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included, going forward. Where a development or test setup needs a certificate, it uses self-signed certificates and does not turn verification off. HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plaintext exception, because certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
